description: An illustrative diagram explaining an exception to the Minimum Mapping Width (MinMW) rule for linear structures in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) land cover mapping. The diagram depicts a linear feature that is initially 10 m wide. This feature narrows to less than 10 m over a segment, indicated to be "≤ 50 m" in length. After this narrowed segment, the feature expands back to a width of 10 m. According to the mapping rule exception, to maintain the continuity of such linear structures, they can be mapped as a single unit even when their width is temporarily smaller than the 10 m Minimum Mapping Width, provided this reduced width persists for a distance of up to 50 m. The entire feature is labelled "Mapped as 1.2.2.2", indicating it is classified as a single entity despite the temporary width reduction.
